content.text:
FINISHERS
More and varied melee kill moves
The game plays a kill move only on the exact swing that kills. With this on, a target that is already low on health can be finished with one, and it dies in the animation. Never the player.

content.help: Kill moves before the very last blow. Off: only the game's own (the exact killing blow). Default: on.
A target at or under this much of its health can be finished with a kill move. Default 30.
How often a melee swing at such a target becomes a kill move. Default 50.
You get the extra kill moves as well, not only the NPCs fighting each other and you. Default: on.

content.text: Each weapon has a list of kill moves, and the game used to play the first few almost every time. With this on, every move your weapon can do is equally likely.

content.help: Evens out the odds of every kill move and paired move. Takes effect at the next game start. Default: on.
Writes every allowed kill move and how it ended to Documents/My Games/Fallout4/F4SE/Finishers.log.
